title: A customer's email reply to the Customer Support address never reaches Desk, while Setup says "Mail is arriving"
label: BUG
date: 9 Nov 2026: agent reply 14:50, customer reply 15:30, checked until 16:12 (Cairo)
env: TAVI staging-desk.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging, owner ndc-staging-owner) · ticket #1 "Check-in" in Customer Support, receiving address customer-support@help-staging.anyware.software · customer mailbox mmohamed@anyware.software (Zoho Mail)

panels.caption: TAVI #1, Customer Support: the agent reply went out at 2:50 PM (Sent). After more than an hour the conversation still has only this one message

TAVI Setup › Channels › Email, at the same time: "Mail is arriving. Customers can write in…", 4 of 4 done, "Mail sent to customer-support@… becomes a ticket"; also "The mail provider did not answer when we checked taviportal.com"
Customer's phone: the agent reply arrived from Customer Support at 2:50 PM, subject "Re: Check-in"
Customer's mailbox (Zoho Mail): reply "test reply" sent at 3:30 PM to customer-support, quoting the agent email from customer-support@help-staging.anyware.software

rows: Arrived at 2:50 PM from Customer Support <customer-support@help-staging.anyware.software>, subject "Re: Check-in".
Sent from #1 (Customer Support) at 2:50 PM, status Sent.
Reply sent at 3:30 PM to customer-support@help-staging.anyware.software, subject "Re: Check-in", text "test reply".
Expected: the reply shows on #1 as a customer (inbound) message, or at least as a new ticket.

Nothing arrived: #1 still has only the agent reply at 4:12 PM (42 min later); no new ticket from that address; Suppressions empty (Quarantine and Spam were empty before, then returned server errors at 3:55 PM).
Says "Mail is arriving. Customers can write in, and replies go out. Nothing is waiting on you." and "4 of 4 done" while the customer reply did not arrive.
"The mail provider did not answer when we checked taviportal.com." The page says this doesn't tell whether mail is arriving.
